text.p: Noble Affiliates Inc said Wednesday its Samedan Oil Corp unit bought an additional 25 percent stake in the Vermilion Block 279 for $10 million.
The acquisition boosted Samedan's stake in the property -- located offshore Louisiana and still being developed -- to 50 percent, Noble said.
It did not say from whom Samedan bought the stake or who owns the other 50 percent. Officials from the company were not immedialy available to comment.
Vermilion 279 now produces about 979 barrels of oil and 4.2 cubic feet of gas per day from two wells.
Noble said it expects the property to produce 5,000 barrels of oil and 35 million cubic feet of gas when it is fully developed.
It also said that Samedan plans to finish drilling six more wells on the property by April 1997.
